# agentgateway_traffic_gateways (Data Source)

Lists the `traffic.gateway` config resources the gateway holds, sorted by id. Use `name_prefix` to narrow the listing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every gateway the agentgateway currently holds, sorted by id.
data "agentgateway_traffic_gateways" "all" {}

# Narrow the listing to gateways whose name starts with "public-".
data "agentgateway_traffic_gateways" "public" {
  name_prefix = "public-"
}

output "gateway_names" {
  value = [for gateway in data.agentgateway_traffic_gateways.all.gateways : gateway.name]
}

output "public_listener_hostnames" {
  value = flatten([
    for gateway in data.agentgateway_traffic_gateways.public.gateways : [
      for listener in gateway.listeners : listener.hostname
    ]
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_prefix` (String) Only include gateways whose name starts with this prefix. An empty prefix includes every gateway.

### Read-Only

- `gateways` (Attributes List) The matching gateways, sorted by id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gateways))
- `id` (String) Stable identifier of the listing: `traffic.gateway:<name_prefix>`.

<a id="nestedatt--gateways"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gateways`

Read-Only:

- `bind_address` (String) Address the gateway binds, when set at the gateway level.
- `listeners` (Attributes List) Named listeners of the gateway. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gateways--listeners))
- `name` (String) Gateway name, which is also the resource id.
- `port` (Number) Port the gateway binds, when set at the gateway level.
- `protocol` (String) Gateway-level protocol: `HTTP`, `HTTPS`, `TCP` or `TLS`.

<a id="nestedatt--gateways--listeners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gateways.listeners`

Read-Only:

- `hostname` (String) Hostname the listener matches.
- `name` (String) Listener name.
- `protocol` (String) Listener protocol.
